insight: Raised a $42M Redpoint-led Series A in Jan 2026; Nike, Netflix and Pentagram use its FAUNA creative agent in production.
name: FLORA
tagline: Node-based creative canvas chaining 50+ AI models into team workflows.
description: An infinite-canvas creative environment where designers chain image, video, and text models into reusable node-based workflows. One subscription covers 50+ models — Veo, FLUX, Kling, Nano Banana, GPT, and more — and the built-in FAUNA agent helps assemble and iterate on pipelines. Pitched at professional teams who want repeatable, taste-driven output instead of one-off prompting.

modelSupport.notes: 50+ image/video/text models (Veo, FLUX, Kling, GPT, Recraft, …) accessible in one canvas.

edge: An infinite node canvas that chains 50+ models into reusable team workflows — built around shared taste rather than one-shot prompting.
pros: Used in production by major brands
cons: Node workflow has a learning curve
